day_shape: 61 items: State Dept sanctions 14 entities/individuals across Iran/China/Belarus/UAE for military procurement, CENTCOM blockade halts 70+ tankers carrying ~166m barrels, IDF strikes 85+ Hezbollah sites, Trump signals possible renewed Hormuz operations.

threads.label: State Dept procurement sanctions package
threads.summary: Secretary Rubio announced sanctions on 11 entities and three individuals in Iran, China, Belarus and the UAE over Iranian arms procurement, including China-based suppliers of satellite imagery used against US forces. A separate State fact sheet designated four further entities for the same satellite-imagery activity.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz naval confrontation
threads.summary: CENTCOM said it is preventing more than 70 tankers carrying over 166 million barrels of Iranian oil from moving, with three destroyers operating in the Arabian Sea; Trump told reporters the US would launch renewed Hormuz operations if talks fail. Defa Press claimed an Iranian navy missile-drone strike on US destroyers, and cited Bloomberg saying no commercial ships have transited since Tuesday.

threads.label: US-Iran proposal and Mojtaba reporting
threads.summary: Trump said he expected an Iranian response to the latest US proposal that night, while Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post cited US intelligence assessments that Mojtaba Khamenei is playing a critical role in war strategy from hiding. Iran International reported Speaker Ghalibaf manoeuvring within the post-war leadership.

threads.label: Hezbollah exchanges in northern Israel
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck more than 85 Hezbollah sites in 24 hours, including weapons storage and production, after rockets were fired at Israeli soldiers in southern Lebanon. Hezbollah fired rockets at the Haifa area and explosive drones wounded three Israeli soldiers.

threads.label: Nuclear sites and IRGC activity abroad
threads.summary: The Institute for Science and International Security said satellite imagery shows at least six Iranian nuclear sites were hit in recent US and Israeli strikes, most tied to weaponisation work. Jerusalem Post reported on a new IRGC-linked group, Harakat Ashab al-Yamin, conducting attacks on Jewish and opposition targets in Europe.

threads.label: Domestic strain inside Iran
threads.summary: IRIB warned of a critical drinking-water situation in Tehran, Yazd, Isfahan, Qom, Arak, Mashhad and Karaj, while Iran International reported worsening water, equipment shortages and a near-rupture with the UAE. A suspected oil spill covering dozens of square kilometres was detected near Kharg Island, and activists warned of an imminent execution of an aerospace graduate student.

threads.label: Khamenei messaging and war-damage compensation
threads.summary: Khamenei's office published economic recommendations from the Workers' and Teachers' Day message urging firms not to lay off staff, and IRIB ran heavy coverage of a 69th-night gathering cycle commemorating the leadership. State media also detailed free duplicate title-deed reissuance and housing loans of 400 million to 2 billion tomans for war-damaged properties.

events.summary_en: Noshaabadi: Iran is ready to help develop security in the countries of the region: The parliamentary director general of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, speaking to Defapress, said: The Islamic Republic of Iran is ready, using all its identity, spiritual, human, scientific and industrial capacities and modern technologies, especially its nuclear and missile capabilities, to help develop the security of other countries in the region. The comfort, welfare and progress of the nations of the region depend on the exit of America from the Persian Gulf and the establishment of collective security without the presence of foreigners, by the countries of the region themselves. events.summary_en: Issuance of licences for two new doctoral programmes at Science and Culture University. Deputy for Education and Advanced Studies at Science and Culture University: Licences for two doctoral programmes in Sports Management and Art Research have been issued. events.title_en: Red Crescent: Provision of 300,000 drug prescriptions at the height of war; uninterrupted service to intractable patients continued
events.summary_en: Red Crescent: Provision of 300,000 drug prescriptions at the height of war; uninterrupted service to intractable patients continued. Mohammad Reza Shanesaz, chief executive of the Medical Procurement Organisation of the Red Crescent Society, speaking to Defapress, said: During the recent war, we provided coverage for more than 300,000 prescriptions across the country 24 hours a day. In Tehran, around 51,500 prescriptions were covered and patients with intractable diseases received their medicines. During the war, we did not allow any disruption in drug procurement and we opened more than 100 haemodialysis beds in 3 provinces; the people should know that the problems resulting from the third imposed war will not prevent us from providing services to our dear compatriots, especially intractable patients.

events.title_en: Payment of housing deposits to war-affected individuals. Deputy Minister of Roads and Urban Development during a visit to Shajarat Tayyeba Primary School in Minaab:
events.summary_en: Payment of housing deposits to war-affected individuals. Deputy Minister of Roads and Urban Development during a visit to Shajarat Tayyeba Primary School in Minaab: Housing loan deposits for repair and construction of houses damaged or destroyed in the war are paid from 400 million to 2 billion tomans. This loan is distributed according to the city's rate, provincial centres and major cities from the mortgage amount placed at the disposal of housing banks to the owners of files formed. The construction of houses destroyed in major cities is the responsibility of municipalities and in other cities of the country is centred on the Housing Foundation.

events.title_en: Iran: US movements in the Strait of Hormuz have catastrophic consequences
events.summary_en: Iran: US movements in the Strait of Hormuz have catastrophic consequences. Iran's Ambassador and Permanent Representative to the United Nations, in a letter to the UN Secretary-General and President of the Security Council, warned of the catastrophic consequences of US activities in the Strait of Hormuz. The consequences of the continuation of US military action in the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz can be catastrophic, extending far beyond the region, weakening international peace and security; a matter for which the United States will bear full responsibility. The United States has also, through the so-called imposition of maritime blockade, repeated attacks against Iranian commercial vessels and their unlawful seizure, and hostage-taking of their crews, committed unlawful acts.

events.title_en: Power of fire: the world's best rocket launcher system
events.summary_en: Power of fire: the world's best rocket launcher system. Recently, North Korea, by conducting a missile exercise, once again demonstrated its offensive capability; whereby the long-range rocket launcher "KN-25" hit targets at a distance of more than 350 kilometres. Estimates show that the KN-25 is a single-stage solid-fuel missile with a diameter of 600 millimetres (0.6 metres) and an estimated length of around 8.6 metres; given its calibre, this missile is closer in dimensions to a short-range ballistic missile than to older multiple launch rocket systems. Many military experts consider the KN-25 to be the best and most powerful rocket launcher system in the world; although China has a system.

events.title_en: Long struggle for a new world order/ Generals are always prepared for past wars
events.summary_en: Long struggle for a new world order/ Generals are always prepared for past wars. Although the nature of war as an armed struggle to impose will on an enemy has not changed throughout human history, the face and nature of conflicts are constantly changing. Every major war changes its face and each era gives it a new nature, only for the next war to implement its reforms. The nature of wars in our era is determined by the end of the 500-year dominance of the West and nearly 40 years of American hegemony. The horizons show a new world order, often called multipolar. In this order, powers of various sizes, belonging to different civilisations.

As a result of this operation and despite extensive efforts to repel the attack by the US Navy, 1 cruise missile and 3 suicide drones successfully struck US destroyers, causing fires. It should be noted that this operation was in commemoration of the commander.
